chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ahmad ibn Muhammad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Malik ibn Atiyya, from Dawud ibn Farqad, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who bought a mature slave girl, and she did not menstruate with him until six months had passed for her, and there was no pregnancy with her. So he (peace be upon him) said: 'If the likes of her tend to menstruate, and that is not due to old age, then this is a defect for which she can be returned.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on returning a slave girl who has not menstruated within six months of purchase?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of '‘ayb' (hidden defect) in sales, specifically addressing the biological maturity of a slave girl. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the absence of menstruation within six months, excluding old age or pregnancy, constitutes a valid defect for return, provided it is not the norm for her age group, reflecting the Shia juristic emphasis on fairness and transparency in transactional contracts.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, and Ahmad Bin Muhammad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Malik Bin Atiyya, from Dawood Bin Farqad who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who bought a slave girl who matured but she did not menstruate with him until six months passed by her, and there was no pregnancy with her. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If the likes of her tend to menstruate, and that does not happen from old age, so this is a defact for which she can be returned’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ahmad ibn Muhammad all from ibn Mahbub from Malik ibn ‘ Atiyyah from Dawud ibn Farqad who has said the following:

“This is concerning my question before abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a slave- girl who is well aware but does not experience Hayd (menses) for six month now with him and she is not pregnant. He (the Imam) said, Tf others similar to her experience and it is not because of old age, it is a defect, because of which she can be returned.’”
